> Eod · 2026-05-27

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\google-ads\validation\eod_report_2026-05-27_pipeliners.txt`

Tuesday. Two reports for the same day: the weekly Alphalete Google Ads review and a Pipeliners conflicting-negatives cleanup.

# Alphalete Trenchless
File: `eod_report_2026-05-27.txt`. Account 140-061-4219. See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Weekly review of the two enabled campaigns (AT | CIPP Residential | Search | CO Springs and Denver). Validation also surfaced a paused third campaign (AT | CIPP Commercial | Search | CO + Denver) and two paused EXACT ad groups.
- Performance: L7 41 clicks, $410.24, 0 conversions. L30 166 clicks, $1,671.38, 6 conversions, $278.56 CPL.
- Audited the 554 existing negatives first, then added 177 campaign-level negatives (83 CO Springs, 94 Denver), all verbatim from the search terms report (phrase match mostly, exact for question queries).
- Added 33 positive keywords (26 Denver PHRASE, 7 CO Springs PHRASE), all verbatim CIPP/trenchless search terms.
- Kept cost-research and "near me" queries in play to keep collecting data. Skipped 11-word queries (over Google's 10-word limit) and terms that would self-block.
- Findings: zero conversions in the last 7 days (check site conversion tracking); Denver's "." shared negative list is empty while CO Springs has 188; CO Springs L30 CPL $476.71 vs Denver $179.49.

# Pipeliners
File: `eod_report_2026-05-27_pipeliners.txt`. Account 721-909-5860. See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Cleared both items in the "Remove conflicting negative keywords" recommendation.
- Conflict 1: broad `plumbing` in the shared list was blocking `trenchless plumbing` and `plumbing pipe lining` across 3 enabled campaigns. Removed only that row (54 negatives kept). Renamed the list from "New by Kim" to "Pipeliners | Universal Exclusions".
- Conflict 2: removed the campaign negative `pipe lining maintenance cost calculator` from "OTTO - Ads - Cured-In-Place Pipe Lining".

# Follow-ups
- Alphalete: decide shared list vs per-campaign for 67 universal exclusion negatives; 3 keyword unpauses deferred; check conversion tracking.
- Pipeliners (low priority): review `fix`, `at joint` and `pipe companies` in the Universal Exclusions list for over-blocking.
